description: Counts a number of cells in a range that are not empty.

params.description: Up to 255 items, or ranges to count values.The first argument is required, subsequent arguments are optional. Arguments can be numbers, logical values, text strings, ranges, names, or arrays.
params.name: args
params.type: string | number | boolean | (string | number | boolean)[] | ApiRange | ApiName

signature: COUNTA(args: string | number | boolean | (string | number | boolean)[] | ApiRange | ApiName): number
